{{Top|leg}}
'''Chrome''' was a type of material which could be applied to a vehicle, such as a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]]. [[Yoxgit/Legends|Yoxgit]] utilized it when he customized his cloud car on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].

Chrome could also be used for [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]]<ref name="H2H">''[[Star Wars: Head-to-Head Tag Teams]]''</ref> or [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="game11">''[[Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea]]''</ref> The shell for the [[C-22 fragmentation grenade]]'' was made of pre-stressed chrome.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
